items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: So, at the end of the term I met a woman that was, her name was Josephine Berkeley.

ctx.x: So what happened now, after that. We're, uh, the rent parties.

Well, we were doin' pretty good at the rent parties.
Well, now, I met a little girl, and this little girl was tryin' to be a singer, too. And Maceo had one, too. So, we used to go up to her house. And she was a little older than we were, and we would play and they would sing.
Well, now, we were beginning to learn keys. But not fast, you know what I mean? The way we played, we was playin' F-sharp and C-sharp, and you couldn't put no singers up there, you see. So, we were getting a little better, now, see. So, at…
Well, I know about it, yes. Tell me.
